description:
Perform a Crossed Gauge R&R (Repeatability and Reproducibility) study. 

1. Open the file '/home/ga/Documents/JASP/MeasurementData.csv' in JASP.
2. Enable the 'Quality Control' module (click the blue '+' icon in the top right).
3. Select 'Gauge R&R' from the Quality Control menu and choose the 'Crossed' design.
4. Assign the variables:
   - 'Part' -> Part
   - 'Operator' -> Operator
   - 'Measurement' -> Measurement
5. Under 'Analysis Options' or 'Graph' settings, enable the 'Graph of variation components'.
6. Save the completed analysis as a JASP project file at '/home/ga/Documents/JASP/GaugeStudy.jasp'.
